propositions: inspect-ai is never imported anywhere in rebar source code; the only reference is the extras registry name string in _optional.py

the [eval] extra exists solely to declare inspect-ai and creates two [tool.uv] conflicts entries and one override-dependencies entry that exist only to work around inspect-ai's stale click version cap

the [eval] extra's declared purpose (smoke-test the inspect-ai eval path) cannot execute in any CI lane because only the weekly/dispatch prompt-eval.yml job installs it and that job is pytest-less and continue-on-error

eval.py's module docstring falsely claims the live run imports inspect-ai lazily through guard_import, contradicting the implementation comment that explicitly states the native solver loop does NOT route through inspect-ai

removing inspect-ai and the [eval] extra resolves the boto3 version diamond (aiobotocore pinning boto3<1.40.62 vs pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock] needing boto3>=1.42.63) and the click vulnerability workaround (inspect-ai caps click<8.2.2; the override held the project on vulnerable click 8.2.1 PYSEC-2026-2132)
